doc: docs/merge-queue-settings.md. The one source for merge queue settings, approving review count and explicitly scoped required checks. Applied by scripts/apply_merge_queue.py (dry-run by default). Required checks roll out only after their producer is installed, backfilled and observed on PR heads and merge groups.

fast_gate.note: ci-ok is the CI gate. The tool reports it fleet-wide and adds or binds checks only for the explicit required_checks targets below; all other required checks are preserved.

review.note: Human approving reviews remain at zero. The exact-head, App-bound review-ok status is the independent review gate on explicitly rolled-out repositories.

required_checks.reason: First review gate rollout: preserve CI and bind independent review to its sole App. Apply only after the documented readiness gates and the cloud contract update.

fast_gate_overrides.reason: The deploy/pins branch is gated by its own check, pin-ok, not by the code gate.

_overrides_shape: overrides: [{"repo": "org/name", "ruleset": "<ruleset name>", "settings": {"max_entries_to_build": 2}, "reason": "..."}]. fast_gate_overrides: [{"repo": "org/name", "ruleset": "<ruleset name>", "context": "pin-ok", "reason": "..."}].
